finding.expected: Preserve the single P7.4 authority and factory surface, but pass dimension collections into the profile validation without pre-coercing unordered inputs (or otherwise validate the original inputs as ordered Sequences before conversion). Add focused regression coverage proving the public factory rejects unordered collections for the six dimensions while preserving ordered caller input exactly. Do not broaden scope, add collection/acquisition behavior, alter P7.3, or change roadmap/control-plane authority.
finding.issue: The public create_tiktok_affiliate_evidence_profile factory eagerly converts every caller-supplied dimension collection with tuple(...) before TikTokAffiliateEvidenceProfile validation. That bypasses _ordered_refs' Sequence gate: an unordered set supplied through the canonical factory becomes an accepted tuple instead of failing closed. Because set iteration order is not caller-defined and may vary across processes, the factory does not preserve caller order and can produce a non-deterministic public profile/projection from an input shape that the direct value constructor correctly rejects. Existing regression coverage tests unordered-set rejection only through direct TikTokAffiliateEvidenceProfile construction, so it does not exercise the canonical factory path.
